key.name: accounts
key.description: The GitHub and GitLab accounts to show, one JSON object per account: id, platform, base (the instance's address), login, method (device or pat) and clientId. No tokens: each account's sign-in is in the GNOME keyring under its id.

key.name: repositories
key.description: List of repositories in owner/name form. Applies to github.com accounts.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Minutes between GitHub checks.

key.name: group-by
key.description: How the window's Issues and Pull requests lists are grouped: "project" (the repository or project), "platform" (GitHub or GitLab) or "organization" (the user, organization or group, merged across accounts by name).

key.name: organization-names
key.description: The friendly name you gave an organization, as plain text: the organization's login (lower case) to its name, the same on every account and platform. Organizations with the same name share a group when the lists are grouped by organization.

key.name: project-repos
key.description: The project each repository belongs to, as plain text: the repository (lower case, owner/name) to the project's name. A repository with no entry is a project named after itself. Kept only in Source Glance.

key.name: project-boards
key.description: Names of projects that came from a platform (a GitHub Project board), kept even when no repository is in them.

key.name: hidden-boards
key.description: Project boards you chose to hide, each by its address (plain text). Kept only in Source Glance.

key.name: layout
key.description: "separate": one top-bar icon per list. "tabs": one icon whose menu has a tab per list.

key.name: toolbar-buttons
key.description: Which lists to show: issues, prs, projects. The sourceglance button is always shown.

key.name: collapsed-sections
key.description: Account sections collapsed in the lists, as list:section (e.g. issues:gitlab). The first GitHub and GitLab sign-ins use github and gitlab; other accounts use their id.

key.name: collapsed-groups
key.description: Repositories and project boards collapsed in the lists, as list:platform:name (e.g. issues:github:owner/repo, or projects:github: and the board's node id).

key.name: widgets
key.description: Cards to show in the window's Glance → Widgets, and on the desktop unless listed in widgets-off-desktop: summary, issues, prs, projects, or a custom widget's id. Cards left out wait under Add widget.

key.name: widgets-off-desktop
key.description: Cards shown only in the window, not on the desktop.

key.name: custom-widgets
key.description: Widgets you made, one JSON object per widget: id (custom- and up to 16 letters or digits), name, icon (app, issue, pr, merge, closed, projects, label or code), kind (issues, prs or projects), account (an account id, or empty for all), relation (any, assigned or review; pull requests only), repos and labels (lists, empty for any) and words (search words).

key.name: widget-opacities
key.description: How opaque each card is, in percent (30 to 100), by card id. Cards not listed use widget-opacity.

key.name: widget-size
key.description: How big cards are, unless widget-sizes gives their own: "small", "medium" (sized from your screen) or "large".

key.name: widget-sizes
key.description: Each card's own size ("small", "medium" or "large"), by card id. Cards not listed use widget-size.

key.name: widget-layout
key.description: Where each card sits in the window's widget area, as the column and row of its top-left cell on a 4 × 4 grid. On the desktop, cards never dragged follow this order (see widget-arrangement).

key.name: widget-arrangement
key.summary: Where widgets go on the desktop
key.description: Where cards never dragged on the desktop sit, in the window's order: "top-right" (a grid two cards wide), "right" or "left" (a column at that edge), "top" or "bottom" (a row along that edge).

key.name: widget-backdrop
key.description: Whether the window's widget area shows your wallpaper behind the cards.

key.name: widget-positions
key.description: Where each card was dragged to, in screen coordinates. Empty: default places.

key.name: widget-opacity
key.description: How opaque cards are, in percent, unless widget-opacities gives their own.

key.name: start-automatically
key.description: Show sourceglance in the top bar when you log in. When off, it stays hidden until you start it from Settings.

key.name: app-launcher
key.description: Add a sourceglance icon to the app grid and dock that starts sourceglance and opens its Settings.

key.name: bar-enabled
key.description: Whether sourceglance shows its top bar and desktop widgets and refreshes. The Top bar switch in Glance → System Tray sets it; Quit turns it off.

key.name: start-request
key.description: Internal. Bumped by the app icon (launcher) to show sourceglance again after Quit.

key.name: quit-request
key.description: Internal. Bumped by Quit, in the top bar or the window, so the top bar, the desktop widgets and the window all stop.

key.name: refresh-request
key.description: Internal. Bumped by the sourceglance window after a change, so the top bar refreshes right away.

key.name: check-updates
key.description: When you log in and when the sourceglance window opens, ask GitHub whether a newer release is out. At login a notification says so; in the window, "Update available" shows in its title bar.

key.name: tasks-expanded
key.description: Whether the window's sidebar shows Issues, Pull requests and Project Boards under Tasks.

key.name: saved-wallpaper
key.description: Internal. The org.gnome.desktop.background values the recommended wallpaper replaced, kept by Glance → Widgets → Apply so Reset can put them back. Cleared when the wallpaper changes any other way.

key.name: install-update
key.description: Internal. Set by the update notification's Install button so the window starts the update, as if "Update available" were clicked.

key.name: open-page
key.description: Internal. Set by the top-bar menu (for example to "about") so the window shows that page.

key.name: token-changed
key.description: Internal. Bumped by Settings when an account is added or removed, so the extension refreshes right away.

key.name: sidebar-narrow
key.description: Whether the window's sidebar shows icons with short names under them (and counts on them) instead of icons, names and counts. On by default. Switched with the sidebar's menu button.
